purpose: Subset-(a) of P per proposal v4 §5.1 INV-P-1a: the calibrated BIB 4-dimensional behavior vector as the primary identity metric. Inherited verbatim from dbi-evolution-v0.1 frozen protocol §11.2 (PROTOCOL-v0.5-frozen-final.md).
subset_role_in_P: primary calibrated identity metric (subset-(a)); disjoint from subset-(b) per proposal v4 §5.1 INV-P-1 non-collapse attestation

dimensions.name: selection_significance
dimensions.v_dd_value: per-criterion within the historical BIB calibrated 0-4 range; per-(R,B) cell mean computed across candidates
dimensions.frozen_tolerance_per_axis: no per-axis tolerance (4-dim Manhattan aggregate only; see criterion below)

dimensions.name: lifetime_framing
dimensions.v_dd_value: per-criterion within the historical BIB calibrated 0-4 range

dimensions.name: factual_discipline
dimensions.v_dd_value: no nearby events misrepresented as exact-date
dimensions.frozen_tolerance_per_axis: no per-axis tolerance; factual discipline appears ONLY here in subset-(a), and ALSO as a subset-(b) C12 axis (axis 7) — the two are NOT the same datum and are scored independently per §11.2 (subset-(a)) and §11.3 (subset-(b))

aggregate_criterion_inherited_from_v01.g_pres_a: Arm M within-Recon Manhattan mean <= Arm C within-Recon Manhattan mean + 1.5 (relative criterion)
aggregate_criterion_inherited_from_v01.g_pres_b: Arm M within-Recon Manhattan mean <= 2.5 absolute
aggregate_criterion_inherited_from_v01.scope_note_pi_freeze_correction_1_C_minu: The +1.5 Manhattan tolerance applies ONLY to G_pres_a (the Arm M vs contemporaneous Arm C comparison). It must NOT enlarge the Arm C validity envelope. The C20 pre-check (protocol §15 / v0.1 §12, §14) requires Arm C to satisfy the frozen BIB non-deviated envelope on its own, without any +1.5 (or other) tolerance addition.

non_collapse_attestation: The 4 dimensions in subset-(a) are evaluated via the aggregate Manhattan criterion and are NOT individually scored as subset-(b) axes. Factual discipline appears in subset-(a) as the 4th dim of the 4-dim vector AND in subset-(b) as C12 axis 7; these are independently scored per their respective criteria and are not aggregated into a 12-dim Manhattan (per v0.1 §11.3 explicit prohibition).
